scope_comparison: October2610.16107 Theorem1.2 is specifically five bodies and expressly conditional on AppendixA computational statements; even an unconditional five-body proof would leave local all N>=5 target. Other October announcements cover only five/six bodies. The thalens all-N route labels itself a conditional proof skeleton with named open bridges; not a complete general solution. Retained Palomar matches are four-body convex results; Hexagon2610.00550 and2610.00467 cover five bodies only, and2610.00526 assumes centered co-circular configurations. These metadata exclusions do not require treating them as general-N proofs.
